description: Contrast (both-directions): RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2 assigns U+0009 TAB the named two-character escape \t. An implementation that instead outputs the six-byte \u0009 is non-conforming: it produces a different pre-image and a different digest. This vector pins both the conforming digest (jcs_n_correct_digest, same as jcs-n-kat-24) and the non-conforming digest (long_form_contrast_digest) so that a test harness can assert the library uses the short form.
